QUALIFICATION TO HOLD PUBLIC OFFICES (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
QUALIFICATION TO
HOLD PUBLIC OFFICES (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 33 OF 2002
An order to amend
the Qualification to Hold Public Offices Order, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary Part I, dated 26-10-2002]
F.No.2(2)/2002-Pub. dated
26-10-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Qualification to Hold
Public Office's (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Article 2, Chief Executive's Order No.19 of 2002

QUALIFICATION TO HOLD PUBLIC OFFICES (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
QUALIFICATION TO
HOLD PUBLIC OFFICES (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 33 OF 2002
An order to amend
the Qualification to Hold Public Offices Order, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary Part I, dated 26-10-2002]
F.No.2(2)/2002-Pub. dated
26-10-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of Article 2,
Chief Executive's Order No.19 of 2002.---In the Qualification to Hold
Public Offices Order. 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No. 19 of 2002), in Article
2, the following explanation shall be added at the end, namely:---
"Explanation.
---For the purpose of this Article the expression "held the office of the
Prime Minister, or that of a Chief Minister of a Province" shall not
include the office held as a Caretaker Prime Minister or a Caretaker Chief
Minister."
